result.question: What is the trend in Apple's research and development spending over the last three fiscal years?
result.answer: Apple's research and development (R&D) spending has increased steadily over the last three fiscal years. In FY 2023 (period ending September 30, 2023), R&D expense was $29,915 million [c1]. In FY 2024 (period ending September 28, 2024), it rose to $31,370 million [c2]. In FY 2025 (period ending September 27, 2025), it increased further to $34,550 million [c3]. This represents a year-over-year increase of approximately $1,455 million from FY 2023 to FY 2024, and approximately $3,180 million from FY 2024 to FY 2025, indicating an accelerating upward trend in R&D investment.
